a.notes:
I marked 12 lines. Two requirements are not fully met: only 2 lines are "along_avenue" where at least 3 were asked for, and the right lamp-head line has only 2 points.

How I measured: poles are dark-centroid tracks on full-res grayscale rows, headed by the centroid of the dark blob; the snow edge is the sub-pixel peak of the vertical gradient (5-px column average).

Shortfalls and why:
- Only 2 reliable along-avenue lines. The more distant right-hand lamps (heads at about (612.4,272.1), (601.5,290.4) and (599.5,302)) do not fall on the line through the 733 and 640 lamp heads, so I left them out. A further left-row head at (476.8,290.0) breaks the slope trend, so it is excluded as well.
- The ground and road area is at grey level 0 to 4, so no kerbs or lane edges can be measured.
- The rough vanishing point of the two head lines is about (508,302).

Lines I skipped as not straight or too noisy:
- The wooden pole at x 1069 to 1076: it has attachments and its top looks bent.
- The chapel wall corners: contrast is too low.
- The left snow-bank edge at y about 355 to 359: it is lumpy.
- All wires and wire hangers.

Distortion: verticals right of centre lean with the top toward the centre (the mast goes from 1080.7 at y=130 to 1085.5 at y=310, mostly in its upper part). The post at x 160 leans the opposite way, which fits barrel distortion. Posts at 326 and 733 also lean slightly with the top to the right, so there may be a small camera roll too.

Accuracy: lamp-head points are good to about 1 px. The bell-tower edge has only about 30 px of usable height, with about 0.7 px of scatter.

Crops are in the annotator's scratch folder kamensk-ann-a (not kept in the repository)

lines.name: thin traffic-light pole near right edge x~1198

b.notes:
I marked 11 lines: 9 vertical and 2 along_avenue. That is one along_avenue line short of the minimum of 3, and I could not find a third one I was sure of. There are no along_cross_street lines.

Method: vertical points are subpixel darkness centroids of each silhouetted pole, measured row by row. The image was converted to grayscale and the background was taken from the sky on both sides. Lamp-head points are darkness-weighted centroids of each dark head blob (the head's centre, not its top edge). No points are smoothed.

Rows left out of the verticals: rows where the pole crosses an attachment, ringing from the large traffic-light housing near the 1198 pole, and the part of the 1083 mast below y about 230, where the wooden pole next to it corrupts the background.

Agreement check: the two lamp-head lines meet near (585, 350). The left line crosses y=350 at x=585 and the right line at x=585.6, and distant car lights sit at y about 355. So the avenue vanishing point is roughly (585, 350).

Left out on purpose:
- The 4th left head (477.1, 289.9) is about 2 px off the line.
- The right head at (612.3, 272.0) is about 3.8 px off its row.
- The x~732 lamp (head 708.7, 185.9) is not in the right avenue row. It probably stands on the far side of the cross street, with the x~947 lamp (head 921.9, 181.5). That would be an along_cross_street line, but there are only 2 points, so I did not include it.
- The wooden pole at x~1072: hardware on it makes the profile jump by about 3 px, and it may lean.
- The chapel's left wall: it overlaps the lighting mast and gives no clean edge. The bell-tower edges are too short.
- The ground (kerbs, snow banks) is too dark to measure.
- The trolleybus wires, as instructed.

Crops are in the annotator's scratch folder kamensk-ann-b (not kept in the repository).
